description: This Kotlin source file defines a NotificationsHandler class responsible for handling notification-related API calls within an Android app. It manages reading notification snapshots, executing notification actions, and parsing input JSON parameters. It also includes an internal interface for providing notification state and a singleton object implementing that interface.

classes.name: NotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: An interface defining methods to read notification state snapshots, request rebindings, and execute actions on notifications.

classes.name: SystemNotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: A singleton object implementing NotificationsStateProvider, managing notification state via DeviceNotificationListenerService.

classes.name: NotificationsHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for handling notification-related API requests, parsing JSON parameters, executing actions, and returning JSON responses.

methods.name: readSnapshot
methods.description: Reads the current notification snapshot, possibly triggering a rebind if not connected.

methods.name: requestServiceRebind
methods.description: Requests a rebind of the notification listener service.

methods.name: executeAction
methods.description: Executes a specified notification action such as open, dismiss, or reply.

methods.name: handleNotificationsList
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve the current list of notifications, returning a JSON payload.

methods.name: handleNotificationsActions
methods.description: Handles requests to perform an action on a notification, parsing input JSON and returning success or error result.

methods.name: readSnapshotWithRebind
methods.description: Reads the notification snapshot and triggers a rebind if necessary.

methods.name: snapshotPayloadJson
methods.description: Converts a DeviceNotificationSnapshot object into a JSON string payload.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, returning null if invalid.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Utility to safely extract a trimmed, non-empty string from JSON parameters.
